item.title: PK gives VOL-leading Oakdale the edge over Manteca
item.description: Manteca had great looks on its first four shots of the game but came up empty-handed against Oakdale in a top-of-the-table tussle Friday night at a fog-filled Guss Schmiedt Field.

item.title: Riptide surges past Sierra for non-league win
item.description: Charles Mapanao hit a pair of 3-pointers in a 10-0 River Islands run Friday night that gave the Riptide an 11-point lead the third quarter, and they held on for a 63-58 non-league boys basketball win over visiting Sierra.

item.title: Squawking about the ‘unfairness’ of housing prices? Perhaps it’s the chicken you prefer
item.description: It all comes down to what chicken you prefer. This isn’t referencing KFC, Chick-Fil-A, El Pollo Loco, Raising Cane’s or Popeye’s.

item.title: Appeals court agrees: Newsom can’t make end run to fund tunnel
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom’s plan to bypass the California Legislature to secure financing for the Delta tunnel has struck out again.

item.title: Manteca garbage will help supply gas to 8,400 homes
item.description: The garbage buried at the San Joaquin County landfill on North Austin Road — including that from Manteca, Ripon, and Lathrop — will help supply gas to 8,400 households served by PG&E.

item.title: Harder seeks 2-year ban on ex-CPUC members to be able to lobby for PG&E
item.description: Congress Josh Harder has introduced federal legislation aimed at reining in out-of-control rate hikes by shutting the revolving door in Sacramento between state regulators and PG&E lobbyists.

item.title: 30% of 100-unit apartment complex under construction on North Main will be set aside for agricultural households
item.description: Los Robles is destined to be Manteca’s most unique apartment complex. Not only is the complex that is being built to serve low-income renters in the Manteca workforce the most strategically placed complex in the city when it comes to walkability to a wide array of amenities, but it has the community’s first set-aside for agricultural households.
